title: Employ staff under the General Retail Industry Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the General Retail Industry Award 2020.

sources.title: General Retail Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: (a) employers in the general retail industry throughout Australia;

reach.note: Retail of goods and services to consumers (cl 4.2); motor vehicle, fuel and parts retailing, hospitality and food services, and the businesses another award covers are excluded. Retail of goods and services to consumers (cl 4.2); motor vehicle, fuel and parts retailing, hospitality and food services, and the businesses another award covers are excluded. National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: General Retail Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 general retail industry means the retail sale or hire of goods or services for personal, household or business consumption including: (a) clothing; and (b) food; and (c) furniture and household goods; and (d) personal and recreational goods; and (e) bakery shops at which the predominant activity is baking products for sale on the premises; and (f) the provision of repair services for household equipment;

reach.condition: except stand-alone butcher shops, which have their own award

assessment.summary: The General Retail Industry Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
